culprit_citations.quoted_text: ITP Aero header row has no investment type, cost, or fair value cells; the following Propulsion BC Newco LLC investment row carries fair value 3,499.
Creative Planning header row has blank investment terms and fair value cells; the following Creative Planning, LLC term loan row carries fair value 48,743.

findings.detail: B01 is counting structural issuer or industry label rows with intentionally blank fair-value cells as missing fair-value leaves even though actual investment rows carry fair values.

rationale: The raw SOI tables show structural label rows with blank fair-value cells, followed by actual investment rows that contain cost and fair value. Examples include table 10 row 3 (ITP Aero header) followed by row 4 with fair value 3,499, and table 11 row 7 (Creative Planning header) followed by row 8 with fair value 48,743. The aggregate fair-value anchor also reconciles: table 58 reports Total Investments before Cash Equivalents fair value of 22,491,891, matching the extracted total implied by zero residual_fv in the flag bundle. The B01 completeness failure is therefore caused by check scope over structural rows, not a real missing fair-value data defect.
